title: The 2 Best Mini Fridges Under $100
metaDescription: Our 2 picks for mini fridges under $100, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at mini fridges under $100 using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Frigidaire EFR176 1.6 Cu Ft Retro Mini Fridge
products.blurb: Key specs: 1.6 cu ft capacity, Typically $90 to $125, frequently on sale under $100, Retro-styled body with a side-mounted bottle opener.
strengths: Retro styling and a built-in bottle opener add real personality at a budget price
Flush-back design maximizes usable floor space
limitations: 1.6 cu ft is genuinely small -- drinks and snacks, not groceries
Plastic door handle feels less durable than pricier models' metal handles
No true freezer, only a small ice tray compartment
features: Typically $90 to $125, frequently on sale under $100
Retro-styled body with a side-mounted bottle opener

products.name: BLACK+DECKER BCRK25V 2.5 Cu Ft Compact Refrigerator
products.blurb: Key specs: 2.5 cu ft single-door capacity, Typically $120 to $150, occasionally near $110 on sale, ENERGY STAR certified, about 212 kWh/year.
strengths: ENERGY STAR certification keeps the extra cost partly offset by lower running costs
Glass shelves and a proper door bin feel more finished than base-tier fridges
limitations: Small top freezer barely holds an ice tray
features: Typically $120 to $150, occasionally near $110 on sale
Small freezer compartment with ice tray

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
We do not list prices or star ratings because they change. Check Amazon for current details.
